title: Anticancer Peptides: Design Principles, Translational Bottlenecks, and Emerging Opportunities.
snippet: Anticancer peptides (ACPs) are frequently discussed as a single therapeutic class, yet the term encompasses molecules that perform markedly different jobs: direct tumor-cell killing, intracellular target modulation, tumor homing and penetration, or selective delivery of a separate payload. title: Multi-Omics Integration Identifies Epithelial-Stromal-Immune Co-Regulators Bridging Ulcerative Colitis and Colorectal Cancer.
snippet: Patients with ulcerative colitis (UC) carry a substantially elevated risk of developing colorectal cancer (CRC); yet, the transcriptional intermediates that bridge chronic mucosal inflammation and colorectal malignancy remain poorly characterized.
